## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation reflects changed behavior.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, personal information, player data, or private server details are included.
- [ ] No Minecraft, Create, mod, resource-pack, or other unlicensed third-party assets are included.
- [ ] UI changes include before/after screenshots when useful.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, and security effects are described above.
